name: image-view
description: See the images you paste into Claude Code as big previews above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags

maxHeight.title: Max image height (rows)
maxHeight.description: Tallest an image preview may be, in terminal rows. It still shrinks to fit the space above the prompt.

maxWidth.title: Max image width (columns)
maxWidth.description: Widest an image preview may be, in terminal columns. It still shrinks to fit the terminal's width.
